scope: FY2027 House HGAB 3rd-reading DA FMR project rows tested against archived DPWH National Road Network geometry and any GAA road-project alignment with usable location data.
method: Each printed FMR start/end coordinate was transformed from WGS84 to UTM zone 51N. The closest point on DPWH national-road line segments was measured in projected metres. GAA project alignments are eligible as additional comparison lines when usable coordinates exist. The integrated GAA project table currently has zero road rows with geometry or coordinate fields; the 862 count therefore uses the DPWH layer only. <=30 m is a likely endpoint connection signal; 30–100 m needs review; >100 m receives a red-flag tag.

otherReviewedSourcesWithoutProjectGeomet: FY2015 DBM DPWH technical GAA lines
FY2016–FY2018 title-classified DPWH GAA project families
FY2019 DBM DPWH technical GAA lines

limits: This measures against the DPWH national-road inventory and any GAA road alignment with usable project geometry; no GAA project alignment was available in the current joined source set.
It does not cover every local, barangay, farm, or private road.
Coordinates are printed FMR project endpoints and may be approximate or need review; proximity does not prove an access connection.

For question 2, a budgeted road that matches the DPWH National Road Network is treated as non-remote, including a national-road corridor crossing city and municipality boundaries. Project geometry is required to test that spatially; titles that explicitly identify a national road are labeled as national-road indicators, while unmatched routes remain unresolved.

The 100 m road-alignment buffer and 250 m sensitivity check are specified for question 2, but cannot yet be calculated: the joined budgeted-road records do not have project alignments. Municipality-name matches are only a remote-area proxy; city-named and unresolved rows are excluded from that proxy.

Current public lodging/resort/event venue POIs (including hotels, resorts, guest houses, short-stay accommodation and event venues) are the intended evidence layer. Residential rental listings are excluded; government sites and public markets are excluded. The current local source set has no nationwide POI layer with those tags, so no business/venue counts are reported yet.
